source: Authorized read-only CUA inspection of rendered Math Academy completed-task DOM
account_context: User-approved current learner session; account identity verified through visible menu. No credentials collected.
timestamp_semantics: Capture timestamps are UTC. Displayed answer dates/times are preserved as UI strings; timezone unspecified. Quiz answer timestamps all equal completion time and do not establish individual answer times.
identity_semantics: question_id comes from DOM question-<id> and helpButton questionid. topic_id and the raw field step_anchor come from questionKP href. Despite that provisional field name, the fragment is example content_id, not lesson step_id: all162 pairs uniquely match example content in the local per-topic lesson JSON; the separate live-history audit preserves resolved step IDs. Occurrence identity is task_id plus ordinal, not question_id alone.
transcription: Selected DOM fields transcribed from CUA output; per-task counts, result totals and elapsed sums checked against the browser-derived summary. Original 217-row progress CSV and 34-task observations left intact. All162 selected question rows and all360 graph topic/color pairs also match FNV-1a32 checksums calculated from the original CUA capture variables. Checksums are transcription checks, not authenticity signatures.

checksum_encoding.algorithm: FNV-1a32; initial2166136261; XOR each UTF-16 code unit, multiply16777619 modulo2^32; lowercase8-digit hex. All captured checksum strings are ASCII.
checksum_encoding.json: Compact JSON array serialization, no whitespace between elements; equivalent to JSON.stringify or Python json.dumps(separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=False).
checksum_encoding.task_rows: Ordered arrays of [question_dom_id,topic_step_href,difficulty_label,displayed_created,displayed_elapsed,result_label]. KP display names were excluded.
checksum_encoding.graph_nodes: Arrays of [topic_id,ellipse_fill], sorted by topic_id lexicographically as strings.
